# Bug Bounty Program Finder - Project Plan ## Project Overview This will be a comprehensive tool to help security researchers find and evaluate bug bounty programs based on their preferences. The application will scrape/aggregate data from various sources, allow filtering by criteria, and provide insights about programs. ## Initial File Structure ``` bug-bounty-finder/ │ ├── src/ │ ├── main.py # Main application entry point │ ├── config.py # Configuration settings │ ├── scraper/ │ │ ├── __init__.py │ │ ├── hackerone.py # H1 specific scraping │ │ ├── bugcrowd.py # BC specific scraping │ │ ├── others.py # Other platforms │ ├── database/ │ │ ├── __init__.py │ │ ├── models.py # Data models │ │ ├── db_manager.py # Database operations │ ├── utils/ │ │ ├── __init__.py │ │ ├── helpers.py # Utility functions │ │ ├── api_clients.py # External API handlers │ ├── webapp/ │ │ ├── app.py # Flask/Django/FastAPI app │ │ ├── templates/ # HTML templates │ │ ├── static/ # CSS/JS assets │ │ ├── routes.py # Web routes │ ├── tests/ │ ├── unit/ │ ├── integration/ │ ├── data/ │ ├── raw/ # Raw scraped data │ ├── processed/ # Cleaned data │ ├── requirements.txt # Python dependencies ├── README.md # Project documentation ├── .env # Environment variables ├── .gitignore ``` ## Core Dependencies ```python # requirements.txt # Web scraping requests==2.31.0 beautifulsoup4==4.12.2 selenium==4.10.0 scrapy==2.8.0 # Data processing pandas==2.0.3 numpy==1.24.3 # Database sqlite3==3.41.2 (included in Python) psycopg2-binary==2.9.7 (if using PostgreSQL) sqlalchemy==2.0.21 # Web framework (choose one) flask==2.3.2 # or fastapi==0.103.1 uvicorn==0.23.2 # API clients python-dateutil==2.8.2 # Testing pytest==7.4.2 pytest-cov==4.1.0 # Utilities python-dotenv==1.0.0 ``` ## Core Code Components ### 1. Data Models (database/models.py) ```python from datetime import datetime from typing import Optional, List from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Float, Boolean, DateTime, Text from sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base Base = declarative_base() class BugBountyProgram(Base): """Model representing a bug bounty program""" __tablename__ = 'programs' id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True) name = Column(String(255), nullable=False) platform = Column(String(50)) # HackerOne, Bugcrowd, etc. url = Column(String(500), unique=True, nullable=False) description = Column(Text) in_scope_assets = Column(Text) # Comma-separated or JSON out_of_scope = Column(Text) min_bounty = Column(Float) max_bounty = Column(Float) avg_bounty = Column(Float) bounty_type = Column(String(50)) # Monetary, swag, etc. is_private = Column(Boolean, default=False) requires_invitation = Column(Boolean, default=False) categories = Column(String(255)) # Web, API, Mobile, etc. last_updated = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow) reputation_score = Column(Float) # 1-10 based on user ratings response_time_avg = Column(Float) # Average response time in days resolution_rate = Column(Float) # % of reports resolved class VulnerabilityType(Base): """Types of vulnerabilities accepted by programs""" __tablename__ = 'vulnerability_types' id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True) name = Column(String(100), unique=True, nullable=False) description = Column(Text) severity = Column(String(20)) # Critical, High, Medium, Low class ProgramVulnerability(Base): """Association table for programs and accepted vulnerability types""" __tablename__ = 'program_vulnerabilities' program_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('programs.id'), primary_key=True) vulnerability_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('vulnerability_types.id'), primary_key=True) min_bounty = Column(Float) max_bounty = Column(Float) ``` ### 2. Scraper Example (scraper/hackerone.py) ```python import requests from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from urllib.parse import urljoin import re from typing import List, Dict from ..database.models import BugBountyProgram, VulnerabilityType, ProgramVulnerability class HackerOneScraper: BASE_URL = "https://www.hackerone.com" def __init__(self): self.session = requests.Session() self.session.headers.update({ 'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/91.0.4472.124 Safari/537.36' }) def get_program_list(self) -> List[Dict]: """Scrape the list of all public programs on HackerOne""" programs = [] page = 1 while True: url = f"{self.BASE_URL}/directory/programs?page={page}" response = self.session.get(url) if response.status_code != 200: break soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser') program_cards = soup.find_all('div', class_='program-card') if not program_cards: break for card in program_cards: program = { 'name': card.find('h4').text.strip(), 'url': urljoin(self.BASE_URL, card.find('a')['href']), 'platform': 'HackerOne', 'bounty': self._extract_bounty_info(card), 'categories': self._extract_categories(card) } programs.append(program) page += 1 return programs def _extract_bounty_info(self, card) -> Dict: """Extract bounty information from program card""" bounty_text = card.find('span', class_='bounty').text if 'No Bounty' in bounty_text: return {'min': 0, 'max': 0, 'type': 'No Bounty'} # Example: "$100 - $5,000" or "$500+" amounts = re.findall(r'\$[\d,]+\+?', bounty_text) if len(amounts) == 2: return { 'min': float(amounts[0].replace('$', '').replace(',', '')), 'max': float(amounts[1].replace('$', '').replace(',', '')), 'type': 'Range' } elif len(amounts) == 1: amount = amounts[0].replace('$', '').replace(',', '').replace('+', '') return { 'min': float(amount), 'max': None, 'type': 'Minimum' } return {'min': 0, 'max': 0, 'type': 'Unknown'} def _extract_categories(self, card) -> List[str]: """Extract program categories/tags""" tags = card.find_all('span', class_='tag') return [tag.text.strip() for tag in tags] def get_program_details(self, program_url: str) -> Dict: """Scrape detailed information from a program page""" response = self.session.get(program_url) if response.status_code != 200: return {} soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser') details = { 'description': self._extract_description(soup), 'in_scope': self._extract_scope(soup, 'in-scope'), 'out_of_scope': self._extract_scope(soup, 'out-of-scope'), 'response_time': self._extract_response_time(soup), 'resolution_rate': self._extract_resolution_rate(soup) } return details # ... additional helper methods ... ``` ### 3. Database Manager (database/db_manager.py) ```python from sqlalchemy import create_engine, func from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker from typing import List, Optional, Dict from .models import Base, BugBountyProgram, VulnerabilityType, ProgramVulnerability import os from dotenv import load_dotenv load_dotenv() class DatabaseManager: def __init__(self, db_url: Optional[str] = None): """Initialize database connection""" self.db_url = db_url or os.getenv('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite:///bugbounty.db') self.engine = create_engine(self.db_url) Base.metadata.create_all(self.engine) self.Session = sessionmaker(bind=self.engine) def add_program(self, program_data: Dict) -> BugBountyProgram: """Add a new bug bounty program to the database""" session = self.Session() # Check if program already exists existing = session.query(BugBountyProgram).filter_by(url=program_data['url']).first() if existing: # Update existing record for key, value in program_data.items(): setattr(existing, key, value) session.commit() return existing # Create new program program = BugBountyProgram(**program_data) session.add(program) session.commit() return program def get_programs_by_criteria(self, criteria: Dict) -> List[BugBountyProgram]: """Query programs based on selection criteria""" session = self.Session() query = session.query(BugBountyProgram) if 'min_bounty' in criteria: query = query.filter(BugBountyProgram.min_bounty >= criteria['min_bounty']) if 'max_bounty' in criteria: query = query.filter(BugBountyProgram.max_bounty <= criteria['max_bounty']) if 'platform' in criteria: query = query.filter(BugBountyProgram.platform == criteria['platform']) if 'categories' in criteria: # Filter by categories (assuming they're comma-separated in the DB) for category in criteria['categories']: query = query.filter(BugBountyProgram.categories.like(f'%{category}%')) if 'vulnerability_types' in criteria: # This would require a join with ProgramVulnerability pass return query.all() def get_program_stats(self, program_id: int) -> Dict: """Get statistics for a specific program""" session = self.Session() program = session.query(BugBountyProgram).get(program_id) if not program: return {} # Get associated vulnerabilities vulnerabilities = session.query(VulnerabilityType).\ join(ProgramVulnerability, VulnerabilityType.id == ProgramVulnerability.vulnerability_id).\ filter(ProgramVulnerability.program_id == program_id).all() return { 'program': program, 'vulnerability_types': [v.name for v in vulnerabilities], 'total_vulnerability_types': len(vulnerabilities) } def close(self): """Close database connection""" self.engine.dispose() ``` ### 4. Web Application (webapp/app.py) ```python from flask import Flask, render_template, request, jsonify from ..database.db_manager import DatabaseManager from ..scraper.hackerone import HackerOneScraper from ..scraper.bugcrowd import BugcrowdScraper import threading import time from datetime import datetime, timedelta app = Flask(__name__) db = DatabaseManager() # Initialize scrapers scrapers = { 'hackerone': HackerOneScraper(), 'bugcrowd': BugcrowdScraper() } def background_scraper(platform: str): """Run scraper in background to update data periodically""" while True: try: scraper = scrapers[platform] programs = scraper.get_program_list() for program in programs: # Get detailed info details = scraper.get_program_details(program['url']) program.update(details) # Save to database db.add_program(program) print(f"Updated {platform} data at {datetime.now()}") except Exception as e: print(f"Error scraping {platform}: {str(e)}") # Sleep for 24 hours before next update time.sleep(24 * 60 * 60) @app.route('/') def index(): """Home page with search interface""" return render_template('index.html') @app.route('/search', methods=['GET', 'POST']) def search(): """Search for bug bounty programs""" if request.method == 'POST': criteria = { 'min_bounty': request.form.get('min_bounty', type=float), 'max_bounty': request.form.get('max_bounty', type=float), 'platform': request.form.get('platform'), 'categories': request.form.getlist('categories'), 'vulnerability_types': request.form.getlist('vulnerability_types') } # Filter out None values criteria = {k: v for k, v in criteria.items() if v} programs = db.get_programs_by_criteria(criteria) return render_template('results.html', programs=programs, criteria=criteria) # For GET requests, show the search form return render_template('search.html') @app.route('/api/programs', methods=['GET']) def api_programs(): """API endpoint to get programs (for potential mobile app or other clients)""" criteria = { 'min_bounty': request.args.get('min_bounty', type=float), 'max_bounty': request.args.get('max_bounty', type=float), 'platform': request.args.get('platform'), 'limit': request.args.get('limit', type=int) } # Filter out None values criteria = {k: v for k, v in criteria.items() if v} programs = db.get_programs_by_criteria(criteria) # Convert to JSON-serializable format result = [] for program in programs: result.append({ 'id': program.id, 'name': program.name, 'platform': program.platform, 'url': program.url, 'min_bounty': program.min_bounty, 'max_bounty': program.max_bounty, 'categories': program.categories.split(',') if program.categories else [] }) return jsonify(result) @app.route('/program/') def program_details(program_id): """Detailed view of a specific program""" stats = db.get_program_stats(program_id) if not stats: return "Program not found", 404 return render_template('program_details.html', **stats) def start_background_scrapers(): """Start background threads for each scraper""" for platform in scrapers: thread = threading.Thread(target=background_scraper, args=(platform,)) thread.daemon = True thread.start() if __name__ == '__main__': # Start background scrapers start_background_scrapers() # Run the web app app.run(debug=True, host='0.0.0.0', port=5000) ``` ### 5. HTML Template Example (webapp/templates/index.html) ```html Bug Bounty Finder

Bug Bounty Program Finder

Discover and evaluate bug bounty programs to maximize your earnings

Quick Stats
  • Total Programs: Loading...
  • Avg Max Bounty: Loading...
  • Platforms: Loading...
Filters

Featured Programs

Advanced Search
Program Platform Bounty Range Categories Response Time Reputation
Loading...
``` ## Follow-up Questions to Complete the Project To make this a fully functional application, I need to clarify several aspects: 1. **Data Sources**: - Should we scrape data only from HackerOne and Bugcrowd, or include other platforms like Intigriti, OpenBugBounty, etc.? - Are there any public APIs we can use instead of scraping (some platforms offer limited APIs)? - Should we include historical data (like past payouts) from sources like HackerOne's disclosure reports? 2. **Database**: - Should we use SQLite (simple, file-based) or a more robust database like PostgreSQL? - Do we need to store historical data (program changes over time)? - Should we implement user accounts to save favorite programs or search preferences? 3. **Web Interface**: - Should this be a simple web app or include more advanced features like: - User authentication - Program comparison tool - Notifications for new programs matching criteria - Integration with GitHub (for researchers to track their submissions) - Do you prefer Flask (simpler) or FastAPI (more modern, async)? 4. **Scraping Frequency**: - How often should we update the program data? Daily? Weekly? - Should we implement rate limiting to avoid being blocked? - Should we cache results to reduce scraping
